title: Arab Culture and Its Pioneers in Somalia
subtitle: A Historical and Civilizational Study
role: Translated, edited and annotated by Prof. Dr. Ali Mohamed Salah. Original work by Dr. Mohamad Hussein Moallin.
description: The first English rendering of Dr. Mohamad Hussein Moallin’s study of the Arab-Islamic dimension of Somali history, translated, edited and annotated by Prof. Dr. Ali Mohamed Salah.

The book reconstructs the sustained exchange between Somali scholars and the wider Arab world before the colonial period, argues that Somalia was an active participant in Arab-Islamic culture rather than a passive recipient, and assembles a catalogue of Somali Arabic intellectual production for future researchers.

endorsements.quote: Arabic written sources concerning the history of Somalia have long remained neglected or insufficiently utilised within the broader field of Somali studies. By making this material accessible in English, the translation allows students and scholars who do not read Arabic to engage with a body of historical evidence that has often remained inaccessible.
endorsements.name: Prof. Dr. Mohamed H. Mukhtar
endorsements.title: Savannah State University, Georgia

endorsements.quote: A significant scholarly contribution to the study of Somali history and to the understanding of Somalia’s longstanding intellectual and cultural connections with the Arab world prior to the colonial period. It should be included among the recommended readings for postgraduate students studying Somali history and civilization.
endorsements.name: Prof. Abdurahman M. Abdullah “Baadiyow”
endorsements.title: Professor of Modern Islamic History; author of Making Sense of Somali History

endorsements.quote: It argues that Somalia was not merely a passive recipient of Arab-Islamic culture, but an active participant in its adaptation, development, and local production. A corrective to Orientalist interpretations that draws on the rich manuscript and intellectual heritage produced by Somali scholars.
endorsements.name: Dr. Mohamed Ahmed Sheikh-Ali “Doodishe”
endorsements.title: Ambassador of the Somali Republic to the State of Qatar

endorsements.quote: The book maps the architecture of knowledge circulation in the western Indian Ocean with a specificity that allows future scholars to build on it rather than repeat its conclusions. I regard this volume as a major step toward compiling and accounting for the sources.
endorsements.name: Mohamud Mohamed Awil
endorsements.title: PhD Candidate, Department of History, University of Pennsylvania

title: Islamic Jurisprudence in the Western Diaspora
subtitle: Theory and Practice in Norway
description: In an era where over 500 million Muslims live as minorities worldwide, the need for authentic, context-sensitive Islamic guidance has never been more urgent. Islamic Jurisprudence in the Western Diaspora addresses this critical gap with unprecedented depth and practical wisdom.

Drawing from nearly 25 years of experience in Norway, Professor Dr. and Shaykh Ali Mohamed Salah presents the first comprehensive jurisprudential framework specifically tailored to Western contexts. From determining prayer times in polar regions where the sun never sets, to navigating complex financial systems, marriage laws, and workplace challenges, this groundbreaking work tackles the real-world dilemmas facing Muslims in secular societies.

Unlike generic legal opinions, this book provides nuanced, locally-anchored guidance that preserves Islamic principles while enabling full civic participation. It offers rigorous scholarship grounded in classical Islamic law yet responsive to contemporary realities, presenting practical solutions for worship, finance, family life, employment, and civic engagement through a balanced approach that maintains religious integrity without compromising social integration.

As Muslim populations in Europe are projected to reach 7.5% by 2050, the questions addressed here will only grow more pressing. This isn't just another book on Islamic law, it's a vital roadmap for preserving faith while thriving in pluralistic societies.

For Muslims seeking authentic guidance, community leaders, and anyone interested in understanding Islam's adaptation to Western contexts, this work offers both scholarly depth and practical wisdom for navigating the complexities of diaspora life in the modern world.

title: Deal Breakers in Marriage
subtitle: When Love Meets Non-Negotiables: A Jurisprudential Analysis in Islam
description: Deal Breakers in Marriage is a practical book for Muslims in the West. It turns Sharīʿah principles into usable tools for real life in the UK, Europe, and North America.
Inside you'll find:
Pre-marital due-diligence kit: a red-flag audit, values worksheet, and a step-by-step guide to discussing deal breakers before nikāḥ.

Contract workshop: 25+ ready examples of shurūṭ you can adapt (housing, education, finances, relocation, polygyny, counselling), with model wording, what's valid/void, and how to record changes grounded in arkān, mawāniʿ, and cross-madhhab notes.
Decision trees for reconcile vs separate, mapping routes to ṣulḥ, imām-led arbitration, and if harm persists lawful dissolution (ṭalāq, khulʿ, faskh).

Case studies from diaspora life: digital deception and secret marriages, immigration exploitation, addiction, financial neglect (nafaqah), coercing a spouse into sin, and abandoning prayer, what counts as a deal breaker and what evidence to keep.
Health & intimacy guidance: a clear summary of ʿuyūb (defects), juristic differences, and practical pathways to assessment and annulment without breaching modesty.
Faith & suitability: navigating al-kafāʾah fī al-dīn, spiritual incompatibility, and contemporary fatwās (including Mālikī nuances).
Civil-law crosswalk: registration, safeguarding, documenting harm, protective orders, and how to align community mediation with local law.
Custody made clear: stages from infancy to sin al-tamyīz and maturity, conditions for custody, and child-centred remedies.

Designed for couples, parents, imāms, chaplains, and counsellors, this book offers checklists, templates, one-page summaries, and conversation scripts, so you can protect dignity, uphold mercy, and act decisively when the line is truly crossed.

title: The Abrahamic Paradigm
subtitle: Pluralism, Salvation, and the Challenges of the Contemporary Abrahamic Trialogue
description: This publication presents two refined versions of a PhD thesis (1996-2000) exploring Abrahamic interfaith dialogue, primarily from an Islamic perspective. It examines the concept of religious pluralism within Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, contrasting exclusivist and inclusivist viewpoints. The work critically analyses the Abrahamic Dialogue Project, assessing its objectives and potential challenges to Islamic identity and doctrine, particularly concerning the notion of a unified "Abrahamic religion".

The author offers a detailed examination of the figure of Abraham across the three faiths and their respective scriptures. Finally, it concludes with recommendations for fostering respectful interfaith engagement without compromising Islam's distinct religious identity.

title: Domestic Peace
subtitle: Quranic Guidance for Building Healthy Family Bonds
description: The rise in divorce rates within Muslim communities, particularly in the Western world, presents a pressing concern that demands urgent attention. In response to this societal challenge, Dr. Ali Mohamed Salah presents Domestic Peace: Quranic Guidance for Building Healthy Family Bonds. Drawing upon his extensive experience in Da'wa activities and counseling, Dr. Salah identifies ignorance of fundamental Islamic marital teachings as a primary catalyst for familial breakdowns. This book aims to bridge this knowledge gap by offering practical insights rooted in Quranic principles and Prophetic traditions.

Through meticulous analysis and compassionate guidance, Dr. Salah illuminates the path from conflict to concord, providing couples with the tools to navigate challenges and fortify their familial bonds. Emphasizing the importance of spiritual and moral grounding, the book advocates for a holistic approach to marital harmony, wherein Quranic wisdom serves as a beacon of light amid turbulent times.

By synthesizing timeless Islamic teachings with contemporary perspectives, "Domestic Peace" serves as a comprehensive resource for individuals seeking to cultivate resilience, understanding, and tranquility within their households. As a testament to Dr. Salah's commitment to strengthening Muslim families, this book stands as a beacon of hope and guidance in the pursuit of domestic harmony.

title: Ten Stories from the Prophet ﷺ
subtitle: Reflections and Insights
description: Stories have always played a crucial role in shaping the perspectives of audiences and readers, capturing their attention and directing it towards the underlying message. The stories of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, however, hold a unique position; unlike ordinary narratives, they form an essential part of divine revelation, imparting the teachings of Islam in a compelling and accessible way.

In Ten Stories from the Prophet ﷺ: Reflections and Insights, Dr. Ali Mohamed Salah continues the classical tradition of delving into the vast ocean of the Prophetic heritage. He draws out pearls of wisdom from these timeless stories, offering deep reflections and practical lessons. This work aims to connect the profound guidance found in the Prophetic tradition to everyday life, providing insights relevant to all spheres and walks of life.

Islam stands out among religions as a comprehensive system that offers a complete code for living, guiding humanity from darkness into light. This book seeks to bridge the gap between the timeless wisdom of the Prophet's teachings and the modern challenges faced by Muslims, ensuring that his message remains a source of inspiration and guidance for contemporary life.

title: The Pearls
subtitle: An Anthology of Lectures on Morality, Spirituality, and Intellectualism
description: This collection comprises a series of lectures delivered on various occasions by the author. As the inaugural volume in this series, it signifies the commencement of a long-term project dedicated to the dissemination of knowledge and wisdom. Future volumes will continue to expand this collection, incorporating new lectures as they are conducted, God willing. Through this series, we aim to preserve and share valuable insights and teachings for the benefit of future generations.

The Pearls: An Anthology of Lectures on Morality, Spirituality, and Intellectualism is an enriching collection of lectures that spans various times and locations, addressing a multitude of topics and themes. This anthology aims to elevate public awareness and foster academic discourse, offering readers a deep dive into the realms of morality, spirituality, and intellectualism. Each lecture, like a precious pearl, adds to the wisdom and understanding of the human experience, providing invaluable insights for both scholars and laypersons alike.

title: Jinn and Black Magic
subtitle: Understanding the Reality and Seeking Remedies in Islamic Theology
description: Jinn and Black Magic: Understanding the Reality and Seeking Remedies in Islamic Theology is a comprehensive exploration of the nature of Satan and the phenomenon of black magic from an Islamic perspective. Drawing upon the Quran, Prophetic traditions, and insights from Christian and Judeo-Biblical studies, the book delves into the complex nature of the devil and its influence on humanity. It thoroughly examines Satan's tactics and schemes to mislead individuals, providing guidance on how to recognize and overcome deception.

The book also explores the reality of black magic, its implications, and potential remedies. It emphasizes Islam's unequivocal condemnation of black magic, considering it one of the gravest sins due to its impurity and deviation from the divine path ordained by Allah ﷻ. Engaging in black magic is seen as leading to further harm and spiritual degradation, diverting believers from goodness and blessings. Through this analysis, the book aims to offer readers a deeper understanding of both the nature of the devil and the severe consequences of engaging in black magic, equipping them with the knowledge and tools necessary to safeguard their spiritual well-being.

title: The Shield of Islam
subtitle: Addressing Confusion and Persuading Sceptics Against Atheistic Ideologies
description: This comprehensive study intricately delves into the multifaceted realm of atheism, meticulously tracing its historical roots, backgrounds, and the diverse stages it has undergone throughout its existence. While acknowledging the historical passages that have played pivotal roles in shaping atheism, the primary emphasis is placed on its contemporary context, particularly manifested in the writings and speeches of new atheists. The analysis aims to reveal the nuanced stances that these atheists adopt towards Islam and Muslims.

Beyond merely exploring historical evolution, the study meticulously examines the contemporary discourse surrounding atheism, shedding light on its intricate interactions with Islam. Through an exploration of past historical passages, the writing aspires to provide a nuanced understanding of the layers atheism has acquired over time. Furthermore, the research incorporates evidence from the Quran and philosophical arguments articulated by Muslim theologians and philosophers. The scope encompasses insights from thinkers from various religious backgrounds and philosophical schools, offering a comprehensive view of the subject.

The book unfolds through three main chapters, each housing several sections and parts, offering a structured exploration of the subject matter. The chapters collectively contribute to a holistic understanding of atheism's evolution and contemporary intersections with Islam.

title: Exploring the Evil Eye
subtitle: Reality and Remedy: An Islamic Perspective
description: Exploring the Evil Eye. Reality and Remedy: An Islamic Perspective takes a rigorous and multifaceted approach to the subject matter. The author presents a well-researched and holistic exploration of the evil eye by combining scriptural references, prophetic traditions, and scholarly insights. The book aims to inform readers about the realities of this phenomenon and provides them with practical tools to seek protection and maintain their spiritual well-being following Islamic teachings.

This book employs a comprehensive and systematic approach. It begins by defining and explaining the evil eye, examining its historical and cultural significance. It then explores the various signs and symptoms associated with the evil eye, highlighting real-life examples and case studies. The author carefully dissects the teachings of Islam to present practical remedies and protection methods that can be incorporated into one's daily life.

title: Qur’an: Moral Compass of the Believer
description: The modern youth increasingly move away from Islamic morals, ethics, and cultural values. As a result, their belief in Allah and the Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ has weakened, leading to doubts and misconceptions about Islam. The rise of atheism among the youth and the proliferation of distorted beliefs and ideologies further compound the situation. Additionally, there has been a noticeable decline in moral values across various facets of life.

Parent-child relationships have become strained, resulting in high divorce rates and a lack of understanding regarding marital morals and rights. Maintaining strong kinship ties is often overlooked, as the younger generation prioritizes personal aspirations over social issues and family matters. The neglect and mistreatment of older individuals and the growing disregard for young children due to the fast-paced nature of modern life are disconcerting trends.

The erosion of moral values can be attributed, in part, to the influence of Western ideals and misleading media portrayals. Traditional values and virtues gradually dissipate, giving rise to a more self-centered mindset.

In response to these challenges and deplorable circumstances and stances, the book "Qurʾān: Moral Compass of the Believer" has been authored. Unlike previous works on morality, this book specifically caters to the West's second and third Muslim generations, aiming to compensate for the lack of an Islamic-cultural environment during their upbringing. By immersing readers in a Quranic atmosphere, the book addresses the pressing issues and offers solutions grounded in the Qurʾān and Sunnah.

title: فقه المهجر في الغرب
subtitle: تأصيل وتنزيل في ضوء الواقع النرويجي
titleEn: Diaspora Jurisprudence in the West: Foundations and Application in the Norwegian Context
description: يتناول البحث "فقه المهجر في الغرب تأصيل وتنزيل في ضوء الواقع النرويجي" دراسة شاملة تهدف لإعادة تأصيل أصول الفقه الإسلامي وتكييفها مع المتغيرات الاجتماعية والقانونية والثقافية للمسلمين في النرويج. يبدأ البحث بمقدمة توضح المنهجية وأهمية الموضوع، يليها مدخل يعرض بإيجاز الجغرافيا والمناخ، والنظام السياسي والإداري، والاقتصاد النرويجي، والمشهد الديني والتطور التاريخي للجاليات المسلمة والتحديات الفقهية التي تواجهها.

يشمل الجزء التطبيقي سبعة فصول تغطي القضايا الأساسية للحياة الإسلامية في الغرب. يعالج الفصل الأول مسائل العبادات في المناطق القطبية مثل تحديد مواقيت الصلاة والصيام وتقويم المناسبات الدينية. يناقش الفصل الثاني قضايا الأغذية، خاصة استحالة المواد النجسة في المنتجات والأدوية، وأحكام الذبح الحلال واللحوم من أهل الكتاب. يطرح الفصل الثالث نقاشا فقهيا حول العمل في قطاعات مختلطة مثل البنوك والتأمين والصحة.

يتناول الفصل الرابع الأسرة من خلال القوانين النرويجية في قضايا الزواج والطلاق والنفقة وعلاقات المسلمين بأهل الكتاب. يركز الفصل الخامس على المعاملات المالية، وتحديدا مسائل الربا في قروض الإسكان والخدمات المصرفية والتأمين، مع دراسة الضرورات الشرعية والواقع العملي. يتناول الفصل السادس العيش المشترك وفق فقه الأقليات، بما يشمل المشاركة السياسية، والحوار بين الثقافات، والتصدي لظاهرة الإسلاموفوبيا. ويختتم الفصل السابع بمناقشة قضايا الوصية والوفاة وفقا للقانون النرويجي، بما في ذلك الموت الدماغي ونقل الأعضاء.
تختتم الدراسة بتوصيات عملية تشمل إنشاء مراكز فقهية مختصة وتدريب الأئمة لتعزيز التوافق بين الثوابت الشرعية ومتطلبات الواقع.

title: الحوار الديني الإبراهيمي في ميزان القرآن
titleLatin: al-Ḥiwār al-Dīnī al-Ibrāhīmī fī Mīzān al-Qurʾān
titleEn: Abrahamic Interfaith Dialogue in the Balance of the Qurʾān
description: يمثل الحوار ركنا أساسيًا من أركان الدعوة الإسلامية؛ ولأهميته تكررت الآيات القرآنية الداعية إليه، فأصبح الحوار مع أهل الكتاب مسؤولية دعوية ملقاة على عواتق المسلمين، ذلك الحوار المبني على التسامح والهادف إلى كل غرض نبيل، فهناك أصل يجمع أتباع الديانات الإبراهيمية (اليهودية والمسيحية والإسلامية)، ويظهر ذلك الأصل من قوله تعالى ﴿تَعَالَوْا إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾، فتلك هي الدعوة الإبراهيمية بمفهومها الشامل وفيها يتضح موقف القرآن من الحوار مع أهل الكتاب.

The Quranic Perspective on Abrahamic Faiths Trialogue. This Ph.D. dissertation delves into the Quranic viewpoint regarding the trialogue among Abrahamic faiths, a topic of significant concern in today's interconnected world. This research addresses the intricate religious issues associated with this trialogue and underscores the necessity for a meticulous examination from a theological standpoint.

The study draws upon the Quran, prophetic traditions, and the works of classical and contemporary Muslim scholars to shed light on this subject. It systematically explores the foundational principles, operational methods, and underlying mechanisms that underpin successful dialogue.

One of the central findings of this research is that dialogue emerges as the most fitting approach for Muslims to engage with individuals of other faiths. This engagement, referred to as Dawa, allows Muslims to communicate their beliefs and values while respecting the identities of others. This approach fosters an environment of peaceful coexistence and mutual understanding among diverse religious communities. Importantly, the research emphasizes that the value of dialogue extends beyond the specific outcomes it may or may not produce; it is a meaningful process in itself.

title: الإسلام والديانتان اليهودية والمسيحية
subtitle: مقارنات في الأصول العقدية
titleEn: Islam, Judaism and Christianity: Comparisons in Doctrinal Foundations
description: This writing sets out to conduct a comprehensive comparative examination of the core tenets of three major world religions: Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. Through a nuanced analysis, it seeks to delineate both the common ground and divergences among these faiths, particularly in their conceptions of God, the nature of revelation, the role of prophecy, and beliefs concerning the afterlife.

Furthermore, it delves deeply into the historical evolution of the sacred texts of Judaism and Christianity, shedding light on the various alterations and adaptations they have undergone over time. Central to the argument is the assertion that Islam, by preserving its original teachings, emerges as the true heir to the monotheistic legacy passed down from Abraham, revered as the father figure in all three Abrahamic faiths. The paper contends that Islam stands apart in its fidelity to the pure monotheism exemplified by Abraham, distinguishing it as the authentic continuation of this theological lineage.

In conclusion, the writing asserts Islam's theological preeminence over Judaism and Christianity, grounded in its steadfast adherence to the principles of monotheism. Through this comparative lens, the writing contributes to a deeper understanding of the dynamic interplay among these foundational world religions.

الهدف من هذه الدراسة -كغيرها من الدراسات المقارِنة بين عقائد هذه الأديان - هو بيان هيمنة رسالة الإسلام على تلك الرسالات السالفة وأنها هي مقياس رسالة التوحيد السماوية التي جاءت بها الكتب المقدسة والتي بمرور الزمن تسرب إليها التحريف بفعل فاعل وعبث عابث وبالتالي انحرفت عن أصل توحيدها الصحيح والذي بسببه اتسمت بالسماوية.

على العكس من هاتين الديانتين، فإن الإسلام ظل - من وقت مجيئه - حافظا على توحيده، ربانيا في وحيه, أصيلا في نبعه، مُحكماً في آياته، كاملاً في تشريعاته؛ فضمنت له هذه الربانية الخلود والبقاء، والدوام والاستقرار؛ فلم يعرف التّغيير والتّحريف أبداً، الأمر الذي أدّى إلى أن يترشح الإسلام -قبل وبعد تحريف تلك الكتب - لأن يكون مهيمنا على فضاء الديانة السماوية -بوصفها دين التوحيد - وكذلك خاتما للرسالات السماوية والتي تجلت فيها العقيدة الصحيحة الداعية إلى توحيد رب العالمين وتنزيهه.

title: التكملة في تحقيق أحاديث من جمع الفوائد للهيثمي
subtitle: قسم التفسير
titleLatin: al-Takmilah fī Taḥqīq Aḥādīth min Jamʿ al-Fawāʾid lil-Haythamī
titleEn: The Supplement: A Critical Edition of Ḥadīths from al-Haythamī’s Jamʿ al-Fawāʾid, Tafsīr Section
description: منهجي في البحث:
عرض ترجمة المؤلف والتعريف بكتاب جمع الفوائد.
إيراد الحديث كاملاً بنصه كما هو في الأصل.
تخريج الحديث من بطون كتب الحديث، كالصحاح والسنن والمسانيد والمعاجم التي أخرجته، أو ما يتيسر الوقوف عليه في بطون تلك الكتب.

إجراء مقارنة بين روايات الحديث التي تم الوقوف عليها، فما كان منها موافقا لنص الحديث الذي في الكتاب الذي يجري عليه التحقيق أشرت إليه باللفظ نفسه، مع ذكر الزيادة اليسيرة التي هي غير موجودة في الأصل، فإن كان الفرق الذي بين الروايتين أو الروايات غير قليلة، بحيث تكثر أو تتكرر الفوارق اللفظية أكثر من مرة يتم إثبات الرواية كما هي.
الحكم على الحديث، وذلك حسب ما قاله علماء الحديث، مع الاقتصار على واحد منهم إن لم يوجد غيره قد حكم عليه، مع التعليق عليه في بعض الأحيان إن دعت الحاجة إلى ذلك، مع دعمه إياه بالشواهد إن وجدت.
شرح الكلمات الغريبة أو المفردات اللغوية التي تضمنها الحديث، وذلك بالرجوع إلى الكتب التي عنيت بذلك.
ذكر بيان معنى الحديث أو الآية، وهذا كثير في البحث إذ قلما تجد حديثا إلا ومعه ذلك البيان المعنوي، وذلك حيث الآية أو الحديث يحتاج إلى بيان أو إيضاح.
ذكر المسائل الفقهية التي تضمنها الحديث أو الآية، وهذا ضئيل وقليل في البحث؛ لكون جل الأحاديث في البحث هذا تدور على محاور تفسيرية، الأمر الذي يقلل من الحاجة إيراد مسائل فقهية كثيرة.

title: Dawada Nafta
description: Dawada Nafta waa buug si qoto dheer u falanqeynaya nafta aadanaha iyo cudurrada ay la kulanto. Wuxuu si faahfaahsan u sharxayaa xaaladaha kala duwan ee naftu leedahay iyo sida loo daaweeyo cudurrada nafta ku dhaca sida hawo-raaca, iscajabka, islaweynida, istuska iyo xasadka.

Buuggu wuxuu ka kooban yahay laba cutub oo waaweyn. Cutubka koowaad wuxuu faahfaahinayaa macnaha nafta, xiriirka ay la leedahay qalbiga, caqliga, jirka iyo ruuxda. Wuxuu sharxayaa sida loo hufiyo nafta iyo sida loola halgamo. Cutubka labaadna wuxuu si qoto dheer u falanqeynaya cudurrada nafta ku dhaca, astaamaha lagu garto, sababaha keena iyo daawooyinkooda.

Dr. Cali Maxamed Salaax wuxuu adeegsaday Quraanka, Sunnada Nabiga ﷺ, iyo aqoonta culimada si uu u sharxo aragtidiisa ku saabsan daaweynta nafta. Wuxuu si gaar ah u falanqeeyey hannaanka ay culimadii hore u daaweyn jireen naftooda iyo casharrada laga baran karo. Buuggan waa il qiimo leh oo muhiim u ah qof kasta oo doonaya inuu fahmo naftiisa, cudurada ku dhaca iyo sidii uu uga bogsan lahaa.

title: Bogsiin
subtitle: Sidee Looga Hortagaa Ka Shakinta Diinta
titleEn: Healing: How to Guard Against Doubt in Religion
role: Translated by Prof. Dr. Ali Mohamed Salah. Original work by Dr. Mudlaq Jaasir.
description: Kitaabkan hortaada yaallaa waa miiddii laga tuujiyey siddeed sanno oo baaris, akhris, wadasheekaysiyo iyo doodo ahaa, aniga oo isku taxallujiyey in aan wixii is lehba dhinac isku mariyo, waxana aan ku dedaalay in aan habeeyo oo quraaro. Waxana aan markaas ka bilaabay meesha ay tahay in laga duulo, taas oo ah in aan saxo ilaha aqoonta laga qaato, taas oo ahayd ka dib markii aan salka u dhigay qaybo ka mid ah hordhacyada muhiimka ah ee shubuhaatka ku sabsan.

Intaas ka dib waxa aan tooshka ku ifiyey manaahijta seeska u ah shubuhaatka, waxana aan xusay kuwayawga ugu muhiimsan waanan naqdiyey, intaas dabadeed waxa aan soo qaatay seesaska lagu dul dhisay shubuhaatka oo waxa aan ka tagay dhif iyo naadir noqonayo. Intaas ka dib waxa aan jeexay khariidad-hawleeddii aan ku burin lahaa shubuhaatka, taas oo koobsanaysa tallaabooyin dhayda ka cad, waxana aan buugga ku soo afmeeray tusaaleyaal xul ah oo shubuhaatka ku saabsan, aniga oo isku dayaya in aan si hawlqabad ah u dabbaqo tallaabooyinkaas aan ku burinayo.

Shubuhaatkuna waa ciiddaas iyo camaarkaas oo kolba waa soo xuubdhacsadaan, in la koobaana waa adag tahay, waxa aan markaas rajeynayaa in buuggani noqdo mid si mugweyn u qaadaadhigaya shubuhaatkii, kaas oo xoogga saaraya in la daweeyo jirridda shubuhaatka, in ka badan inta uu daweynayo kaamaheeda.

Waxana xikmadda ka mid ah in xididdada loo siibo geedka xun, halkii la isku hawli lahaa in la gaagaabiyo laamaha qaayisay; maxaa yeelay haddii aad laamaha gaagaabiso waxa soo biqlaysa uun laan kale, haddii se aad geedka gabigiisaba xididdada u siibto dhammaan laamihii oo dhan ayaa wada dhacaya, xitaa haddii uu geedkaasi lahaa kun laamood!

titleEn: Awareness: The Muslim’s Life Today and Tomorrow

description: Baahida ay ummadu u qabto muxaadarooyinka culimada awgeed, waxaan go'aansadey in aan qoro buuggan, oo aan ku ururiyo qaar ka mid ah muxaadarooyinka Sh. Dr Cali Maxamed Saalax.

Sheekhu waa mid ka mid ah culimada waqtigooda, naftooda iyo maalkoodaba u huray dacwada iyo cilmiga. Aqoontiisa iyo dacwadiisa ummada ayaa ku kala baahsan baraha bulshada iyo ilaha kale ee maanta dadku aqoonta u raadsadaan. Sidaas darteed, waxaan xil iska saarey in aan ka dhaxal-reebo aqoontiisa qiimaha leh.

Qorshahayguna waa in dhamaan muxaadaraadka uu duubay Dr Cali iyo culimada kaleba, aan ku sameeyo qoraal dhaxal-reeb ah oo faa'ido u noqon kara jiilalka soo socda, Haddii uu Alle ﷻ yiraahdo. Wixii sax ah waxay tahay tawfiiqda Alle ﷻ, wixii khaladanna waa wax ka yimid naftayda iyo sheeydaan.
